evidence: Deterministic check of all 240 units: zero mismatches on qualification, disposition, action_type, follow_up_days and claim_code against the frozen policy; population complete with no duplicate or orphan ids (141 nurture, 75 qualify, 16 disqualify, 8 hold)

Every unit's evidence cites employees, fit_score, intent, region and consent_hold with values exactly matching source.json; all 240 next_action strings embed the exact signal id and an explicit unsent marker, with no affirmative send/meeting/customer-fact claims

Exception classes handled correctly: all Restricted-Zone and <20-employee accounts (A009, A014, A031, A038, A069, A074, A091, A098, A129, A134, A158, A171, A194, A209, A218, A231) routed to disqualify/no-contact/day 0, all eight consent holds to hold/consent-review/day 0, and fit=70 boundary cases (A046, A103, A160, A217) correctly qualified as inclusive

All 34 regulated accounts, including every consequence_class=high account (A017, A041, A063, A088, A109, A127, A151, A177, A203, A229), carry claim_code=evidence-only with correct routing; no unregulated account uses evidence-only

Uncertainty calibration is inconsistent across the population: A001-A040 flag fit staleness and intake-only intent, while the other 200 units assert 'None material' or 'None beyond recorded fields' for identical frozen data, an overconfident claim for 160 of them

Cosmetic style seams: boolean casing drift (intent=True vs intent=true), a 'company' field present only in A121-A160, and four distinct follow_up_trigger phrasings; core schema stays uniform and machine-checkable

No aggregate owner summary (counts, priority ordering, or review surface) accompanies the flat 240-unit array, so owner-facing native readiness is adequate for deterministic verification but not yet a prepared review experience

worst_unit.defect: Consent-hold no-contact account whose next_action is phrased as 'Draft (unsent) outreach' without no-contact labeling; all policy fields still correct and nothing sent
